# CG-REQ-025: Request value constraint relaxed

A request constraint became looser or a pattern was removed.

**Why it matters:** Looser constraints widen accepted requests.

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| Area | [Requests](./#req) |
| Direction | request |
| Detects | `schema.constraintChanged`, `schema.patternChanged` |
| Severity | breaking: high · potentially breaking: medium · undetermined: medium |
| Classification can be overridden | no (the rule only fires when the change is breaking by definition) |

## Message

> {what} was relaxed in {where}.
>
> All previously valid values remain valid.
>
> **Fix:** No action needed.

## Examples

Each example is an executed test case of the rule (`packages/engine/test/compat/fixtures.ts`).

### Fires: maxItems 10 → 20

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      post:
-       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: array, maxItems: 10}}}}
+       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: array, maxItems: 20}}}}
        responses: {'204': {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** Non-breaking, info. `maxItems` was relaxed in POST /x: the request body (application/json).

### Fires: pattern removed

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      post:
-       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: string, pattern: '^a'}}}}
+       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: string}}}}
        responses: {'204': {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** Non-breaking, info. `pattern` was relaxed in POST /x: the request body (application/json).

### Does not fire: tightened

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      post:
-       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: array, maxItems: 20}}}}
+       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: array, maxItems: 10}}}}
        responses: {'204': {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** no finding from this rule.

## Silence or tune it

```yaml
rules:
  ignore:
    - rule: CG-REQ-025
      operation: "GET /example"   # optional: narrow it down
      reason: "Explain why this is acceptable"
      expires: 2027-01-01         # optional
  overrides:
    CG-REQ-025: { severity: low }
```
